Includes mobile #137, the patient's appointment view: their pending request can be cancelled ('Cancelar pedido'), a clinic's proposed time can be accepted or declined, an upcoming scheduled/confirmed appointment offers 'Pedir remarcação' only before it starts, and cancelling means talking to the clinic.
